The '''Sevari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] ''[[Sevari Cabal]]'',<ref name="The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref> which carried [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]] who eventually became the ancestors of the [[Sevari]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|140-141|Sevarcos}}</ref> the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] inhabitants of the<ref name="The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos" /> [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sevarcos">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sevarcos system/Legends|Sevarcos system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]].<ref name="The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sevari system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-4.<ref name="TEA" />
